messages:
Asha (CS): FYI MerchantX just escalated — after yesterday's model rollout their product-summary endpoint is inserting an extra "Note:" paragraph at the end of many responses. They say it wasn't present before.
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Yep — we rolled the new SDK and then saw these across ~12% of orders. Example attached below. Not sure if it's a prompt change or model drift.
Asha (CS): Can you paste one or two full request/response pairs (redact PII)? Also need the model and model_version they were hitting and whether they used streaming.
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Pasted minimal repro:
```
Request (POST /v1/generate)
headers: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>, Redwood-Model: rwd-open-7b, Model-Version: v2.4.1
body: {"input": "Summarize this order: item A x2, item B x1, total $32"}

Response:
"Order summary:
- item A x2
- item B x1
Total: $32
Note: Please verify shipping address before dispatch."
```
MerchantX - Sam (customer): The extra 'Note:' line is the regression. Previously response ended at total.
Asha (CS): Thanks — helpful. Devon, can you triage model-side? Is there a rollout that could introduce hallucinated postambles?
Devon (ML Eng): I'll run a quick differential on v2.4.1 vs previous version (v2.4.0). Two quick asks: 1) can Sam share the exact request headers they used including any custom system prompt or "temperature"? 2) can they run the same request with `model: rwd-open-7b@v2.4.0` to confirm it disappears?
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Headers: no custom system prompt, temperature: 0.0, top_p: 0.9. We can test v2.4.0 now and report.
Logan (SRE): I'll also check if we rewrote suffix prompts in edge routing or applied any post-processing hooks for that customer around the rollout windows (no config changes expected but will verify).
redwood-bot: deploy-notify: rollout rwd-open-7b v2.4.1 -> 2024-11-06T02:14:12Z (canary -> 80% prod).
Devon (ML Eng): Preliminary diff: v2.4.1 introduced a slightly stronger end-of-sequence bias in the tokenizer penalty heuristics to reduce truncation. Could accidentally favor short trailing sentences like 'Note:' as a generated closure. Need a controlled repro set.
Asha (CS): MerchantX can you run three things and paste results: 1) same request but set `model: rwd-open-7b@v2.4.0` 2) run again with `temperature: 0.0` and `max_tokens: 60` explicitly 3) include the request id from the response headers (x-rwd-request-id) if present.
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Ran test 1: v2.4.0 result — no Note line. Ran test 2 (v2.4.1 with max_tokens 60): still seeing Note. x-rwd-request-id: rwd-req-0a1b2c3d.
Devon (ML Eng): Good repro, thanks. Can you also paste the raw prompt logs (we only need redacted content) for a few of the affected calls so I can feed them to our eval harness. The minimal one you shared is perfect.
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Uploaded 5 redacted logs to the secure share: https://share.internal/merchantx/repro-logs (access granted to redwood/*).
Logan (SRE): Checked infra metrics for that rollout window — no change in latency or error spike. No middleware postprocessing found.
Devon (ML Eng): Running evals now on 5 examples across v2.4.0 and v2.4.1. Also will run with the old tokenizer penalty settings. Expect preliminary answer in ~30m.
Asha (CS): If it looks like model heuristics, we should consider a targeted rollback for the heuristic change or a hotfix that suppresses trailing single-line postambles. Devon, can you craft config toggles we can flip per-customer?
Devon (ML Eng): Yes — we have a per-route generation config flag (suffix_penalty_enabled). I'll test disabling it as a canary for MerchantX traffic.
redwood-bot: infra-action: created task INF-1129 to toggle suffix_penalty_enabled=false for route merchantx-prod.
Devon (ML Eng): Update: on our eval harness, 4/5 examples produced the unwanted 'Note:' under v2.4.1 and 0/5 on v2.4.0. Disabling suffix_penalty in simulation removes it for all 5.
Asha (CS): Recommendation: temporary config flip for MerchantX route + communicate to customer that we're reverting that heuristic while we refine it. Sam — want us to apply the toggle now to confirm in production?
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Please do, ASAP. It's causing downstream parsing breaks. :grimacing:
Logan (SRE): Toggling in 2 minutes; will monitor.
redwood-bot: action-log: toggled suffix_penalty_enabled=false for merchantx-prod at 1735809400 by ops(automation).
Logan (SRE): Initial check — note occurrences dropped to ~0.3% from ~12% in sampled traffic. No errors.
Asha (CS): Closing loop — Devon will follow up with a follow-up patch to the heuristic and longer-term regression tests. Sam, thanks for quick repro and logs.
Devon (ML Eng): I'll open a changelist with improved heuristic + unit tests on prompt endings and link it here when ready. :mortar_board:
MerchantX - Sam (customer): Thanks all, appreciate the fast turnaround :heart:
